GameplayEvent Rules10 sections
Special Notes

◆ This event is a collaboration with Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon?. The event is named "Encounter in Another World" and also "Is It Wrong to Live a Slow Life in Isekai?".

◆ This event will not return in the future. After it ends, there will be no way of obtaining the event's exclusive characters.

◆ All event items will be removed or convert into other items after the event ends. Likewise, all the task and gacha progress will be removed.

◆ In Achievements, you can obtain the SSR+ Family character, Hestia. Hestia fragments can be spent to elevate her rarity to UR★. After upgrading her to UR★, you will be able to choose up to 5 Fellows to receive her Blessings.

◆ In the Adventure Gacha, you can pull the SSR+ Fellow, Ais. Each duplicate Ais pulled will automatically convert into 400 Ais Fragments. Ais Fragments can be spent to elevate her rarity to UR. After upgrading her to UR, you will be able to use Ais Fragments to increase this character's Stella Level.

Event Overview

◆ In this event, you will need to use your stamina to explore Pthahnil's Dungeon and assist Bell in finding his friends.

Exploration

◆ In the initial state, the entire game board is shrouded in fog. Consuming stamina to clear obstacles and collect materials will gradually dispel the fog.

◆ Stamina will automatically recover over time, with 1 point restored every 5 minutes. Activating the event pass can increase the recovery speed and raise the stamina cap. Additionally, stamina can be restored by using Juice and other recovery items.

Main Quest

◆ The main quest tasks will guide you in assisting Bell Cranel and his friends.

◆ Completing main quest tasks will unlock more tasks.

◆ After completing all the main quest tasks, you will get exclusive Exhibits and Titles.

Side Quest

◆ Collection tasks provide additional exploration goals beyond the main quest.

◆ Gain plenty of rewards by completing all the collection tasks.

Event Pass

◆ When you collect materials and clear obstacles, you will earn a given amount of Pass Points based on the stamina consumed.

◆ Claim rewards by reaching certain Pass Point milestones. Purchasing the event pass unlocks premium rewards.

◆ Purchasing the event pass will unlock items that speed up the stamina recovery and raise the stamina cap.

Endless Exploration

◆ The Endless Exploration can be activated after completing all the main quest tasks. In this mode, stamina is consumed rapidly. Each round consumes 10 Stamina and yields item rewards.

◆ Spending stamina in Endless Exploration does not earn Pass Points or advance the task progress; instead, it increases your Achievement Points. We recommend that you use your excess stamina in Endless Exploration after completing the map exploration.

Achievements

◆ Earn Achievement Points by consuming stamina during exploration. You will be able to claim corresponding rewards after reaching certain score thresholds.

◆ Stamina consumed in Map Exploration and Endless Exploration will contribute to Achievement Points.

Event Expo

◆ During the event, a series of Expo challenges will be unlocked. Each challenge has 5 difficulty levels to play.

◆ Expo stages unlock over time. You must complete any difficulty of the previous stage to challenge other stages.

◆ Passing all the Expo challenges in any difficulty will earn you 10 Adventure Tickets.

Ranking

◆ During the event, improving the power of any Fellow will increase your ranking score.

◆ Upon the event's conclusion, you will receive rewards based on your place in the ranking. If you ranked among the top 3 and have reached 20,000 Intimacy with Hestia, you will win an exclusive Title.

From Last Place to Champions — Rally the quirky Team Fairy Tail in their unexpected sports day debut, and take down every opponent!

Duration7, 10, 14, or 21 daysDefault finish hour24:00UnlockClear Stage 4-6

Core Rewards

NatsuFellow · NatsuLucyFamily · LucyGrayFellow · GrayErzaFellow · ErzaCostume [Ignite the field!] (★4)Fellow Costume · NatsuWendyFamily · WendyIgneelFamiliar · IgneelCarlaFamiliar · CarlaHappyFamiliar · Happy
GameplayEvent Rules14 sections
Special Notes

◆ This event is a collaboration with FAIRY TAIL. The event is named "Fight! FAIRY TAIL and the Magic Academy Sports Day!," and also "Fight! Magic Academy Sports Day!".

◆ This event will not return in the future. After it ends, there will be no way of obtaining the event's exclusive costumes, characters and familiars.

◆ Enter the game board for a brief play and receive the SSR Fellow Natsu for free. You can use Natsu 's Crystal Fragments to upgrade his rarity to SSR+ and UR★. Obtain these fragments from Achievements.

◆ Once Natsu reaches the SSR+ quality, the [Resonance Effect] feature is unlocked, allowing players to Resonate with a chosen Fellow, significantly enhancing their power. Furthermore, upgrading Natsu to UR★ unlocks the [Resonance skill] feature.

◆ When Natsu's rarity reaches the UR★ quality, the Stella feature will unlock.

◆ All event items will be removed or convert into other items after the event ends. Likewise, all the task and gacha progress will be removed.

Event Overview

◆ From Last Place to Champions — Rally the quirky Team Fairy Tail in their unexpected sports day debut, and take down every opponent!

Exploration

◆ In the initial state, the entire game board is shrouded in fog. Consuming stamina to clear obstacles and collect materials will gradually dispel the fog.

◆ Stamina will automatically recover over time, with 1 point restored every 5 minutes. Activating the event pass reduces the recovery time per point to 4 minutes and increases the stamina cap to 600. Additionally, stamina can be restored by using recovery items.

Exploration Buff

◆ When consuming Stamina during exploration, there is a chance to recover half of it. This probability starts at 0%.

◆ You can increase the stamina recovery probability by getting the event's exclusive characters. The return probability will increase by 10% after activating a character, with an additional 5% if the character's rarity is UR. Each time the Stella is upgraded one level, the return probability increases by 1%, with an additional 0.5% per Stella Level if the character's rarity is UR.

Story Mission

◆ The story missions will guide you in completing the Sports Day.

◆ Completing the current story missions will unlock more tasks.

◆ After completing all the story missions, you will get exclusive Exhibits and Titles.

Side Quest

◆ Collection tasks provide additional exploration goals beyond the main quest.

◆ Gain plenty of rewards by completing all the collection tasks.

Event Pass

◆ When you collect materials and clear obstacles, you will earn a given amount of Pass Points based on the stamina consumed.

◆ Claim rewards by reaching certain Pass Point milestones. Purchasing the event pass unlocks premium rewards.

◆ Activate the event pass to receive 10 gacha tickets and a SSR Family Wendy, and to unlock special item effects. The pass will also allow you to reduce the stamina recovery time per point to 4 minutes and increase the stamina cap to 600 points.

Endless Exploration

◆ The Endless Exploration can be activated after completing all the main quest tasks. In this mode, stamina is consumed rapidly. Each round consumes 10 Stamina and yields item rewards.

◆ Spending stamina in Endless Exploration does not earn Pass Points or advance the task progress; instead, it increases your Achievement Points. We recommend that you use your excess stamina in Endless Exploration after completing the map exploration.

◆ The exploration buff effects on stamina recovery will also apply in the Endless Exploration mode.

Achievements

◆ Earn Achievement Points by consuming stamina during exploration. You will be able to claim corresponding rewards after reaching certain thresholds.

◆ Stamina consumed in Map Exploration and Endless Exploration will contribute to Achievement Points.

Event Expo

◆ During the event, a series of Expo stages will be unlocked. Each stage has 5 difficulty levels.

◆ Expo stages unlock over time. You must complete any difficulty of the previous stage to challenge next stages.

◆ Completing stages in any difficulty level rewards you with 10 gacha tickets.

◆ Passing all the Expo challenges will reward you an exclusive permanent title.

Ranking

◆ During the event (excluding the reward claiming period), improving Fellow Natsu's power can improve your ranking score.

◆ Upon the event's conclusion, you will receive rewards based on your place in the ranking. If you ranked among the top 3, and Natsu has reached 10000 Aptitude, you will win an exclusive permanent title.

Souvenir Shop

◆ You can obtain Sports Day Insignias through exploration or insignia bundles.

◆ Collect enough insignias to exchange for rewards, including the Limited Natsu Costume, at the Souvenir Shop.

Familiar Gacha

◆ You can use Gacha Tokens to draw Familiar Match Fruits in the Familiar Gacha, exchangeable for limited-edition Familiar Fragments.

◆ Collect limited-edition Familiar Fragments to redeem Limited Familiars or upgrade corresponding Familiars' stars.

Recharge Rebate

◆ During the event (including the reward claiming period), you can claim Recharge Rebate rewards by completing the corresponding tasks.

VariationDragon Maid on HiemspresentMaidragon_EN

On this Hiemspresent, some unexpected visitors from another world arrive in the village. A heartwarming story unfolds here.

Duration7, 10, 14, or 21 daysDefault finish hour24:00UnlockClear Stage 4-6

Core Rewards

KannaFellow · KannaTohruFellow · TohruElmaFellow · ElmaFafnirFellow · FafnirLucoaFellow · Lucoa
GameplayEvent Rules9 sections
Special Notice

◆ All event items will be cleared or converted into other items after the event ends. All event task progress and guarantee progress will be cleared.

Event Overview

◆ During the event, players can spend stamina to clean up the abandoned park and assist Tohru and others in organizing the Hiemspresent.

Exploration

◆ To assist Tohru and others, Transcenders need to explore the abandoned park, gather various useful materials, and eventually decorate the park square as the party venue of Hiemspresent.

◆ Collecting materials and clearing obstacles on the map require stamina.

◆ Stamina automatically recovers over time, replenishing 1 stamina every 5 minutes. It can also be restored by using items like hot chocolate and Hiemspresent Turkey.

◆ Initially, the entire map is covered in fog, and clearing obstacles will gradually disperse the fog on the map.

Story Tasks

◆ Story tasks will guide Transcenders in assisting Tohru and others.

◆ After completing the current story task, subsequent story tasks will be automatically unlocked.

◆ Completing all story tasks will reward you with exclusive exhibit rewards.

Collection Tasks

◆ Collection tasks provide additional exploration goals other than the main storyline.

◆ Completing all collection tasks will grant generous rewards.

Hiemspresent Battle Pass

◆ Transcenders will earn battle pass points based on the stamina consumed when collecting materials and clearing obstacles.

◆ Once the battle pass points reach a specified value, rewards can be claimed. Purchasing the battle pass unlocks advanced rewards.

◆ After purchasing the battle pass, you'll receive support from Pom-Pom Plow Team. It can directly clear obstacles nearby and obtain all materials within the range.

Endless Exploration

◆ Transcenders can consume stamina to perform endless exploration. Each round of endless exploration consumes 10 stamina points and grants item rewards.

◆ Endless exploration does not earn battle pass points nor advance tasks. It is recommended to use any leftover stamina for endless exploration after completing map exploration.

Achievements

◆ After consuming a certain amount of stamina, Transcenders can claim rewards for the corresponding tier.

◆ Stamina consumed in map exploration and endless exploration will be counted.

Event Expo

◆ During the event, a series of Expo stages will be unlocked. Each stage has 5 difficulty levels.

◆ Expo stages unlock over time, with 2-3 stages unlocking each day. Transcenders must complete any difficulty of the previous stage to challenge subsequent stages.

◆ Completing all Expo stages at any difficulty will earn a limited character.

Variation氷雪の町校外実習～頑張れ！モンスター娘！MonsterGirl_EN

何人のモンスター娘たちがうっかり氷雪の町へと迷い込みました。彼女たちと一緒に、氷雪の催し物を体験して、楽しい冬の日を過ごしましょう！

Duration7, 10, 14, or 21 daysDefault finish hour24:00UnlockClear Stage 4-6

Core Rewards

MiaFellow · MiaラクネラFamily · ラクネラセントレアFamily · セントレアメロFamily · メロ
GameplayEvent Rules9 sections
Special Notice

◆ This event will not rerun. All event items will be cleared or converted into other items after the event ends. All event task progress and guarantee progress will be cleared.

Event Overview

◆ イベント期間中、スタミナを消費して氷雪の町の掃除をし、ミーアたちと共に氷雪フェスの準備をしましょう。

Exploration

◆ ミーアたちを手伝うために、氷雪の町を探索し、役に立てる様々な素材を集めます。最終的に氷雪の町を氷雪フェスの会場に飾り付けます。

◆ Collecting materials and clearing obstacles on the map require stamina.

◆ スタミナは時間経過とともに自動回復します（5分に1Pt）。ホットココアと氷雪フェス七面鳥を使うなどの方法でスタミナを回復させることもできます。

◆ Initially, the entire map is covered in fog, and clearing obstacles will gradually disperse the fog on the map.

Main Quest

◆ メインミッションを進めることで、ミーアたちへの協力を完了できます。

◆ Completing the current main quest tasks will unlock more tasks.

◆ Completing all tasks will grant limited Exhibit rewards.

Collection Tasks

◆ Collection tasks provide additional exploration goals other than the main storyline.

◆ Completing all collection tasks will grant generous rewards.

フェスバトルパス

◆ Transcenders will earn battle pass points based on the stamina consumed when collecting materials and clearing obstacles.

◆ Once the battle pass points reach a specified value, rewards can be claimed. Purchasing the battle pass unlocks advanced rewards.

◆ フェスバトルパスを購入すると、タマタマお助け隊を使用できるようになります。タマタマお助け隊を使用すると、スタミナを消費せず一定範囲内のすべての障害物をクリアし、相応する報酬を直接獲得できます。

Endless Exploration

◆ Transcenders can consume stamina to perform endless exploration. Each round of endless exploration consumes 10 stamina points and grants item rewards.

◆ Endless exploration does not earn battle pass points nor advance tasks. It is recommended to use any leftover stamina for endless exploration after completing map exploration.

Achievements

◆ After consuming a certain amount of stamina, Transcenders can claim rewards for the corresponding tier.

◆ Stamina consumed in map exploration and endless exploration will be counted.

Event Expo

◆ During the event, a series of Expo stages will be unlocked. Each stage has 5 difficulty levels.

◆ Expo stages unlock over time. You must complete any difficulty of the previous stage to challenge next stages.

◆ Completing all Expo stages at any difficulty will earn a limited character.

VariationMushoku Tensei and Magic Creativity ShowMushoku

Magic Creativity Show is being held in Drakenberg! With Trady's invitation in hand, team up with your fellows from another world and join the competition in joy!

Duration7, 10, 14, or 21 daysDefault finish hour24:00UnlockClear Stage 4-6

Core Rewards

Roxy MigurdiaFellow · Roxy MigurdiaSylphiette GreyratFamily · Sylphiette GreyratAisha GreyratFellow · Aisha GreyratNorn GreyratFellow · Norn GreyratRudeus GreyratFellow · Rudeus Greyrat
GameplayEvent Rules13 sections
Special Notice

◆ This event is a collaboration with Mushoku Tensei,titled Mushoku Tensei and Magic Creativity Show, or simply Magic Creativity Show.

◆ After it ends, there will be no way to obtain the event-exclusive characters

◆ Play through the exploration stage briefly to claim the SSR Fellow Roxy Migurdia for free. You can use Roxy Migurdia Crystal Fragments to upgrade her rarity to SSR+ and UR★. These fragments can be obtained from Achievements.

◆ Once Roxy Migurdia reaches the SSR+ quality, the [Resonance Effect] feature is unlocked, allowing players to resonate with a chosen Fellow, significantly enhancing their power. Upon upgrading Roxy Migurdia to UR★, the [Resonance Skill] feature becomes available.

◆ Once Roxy Migurdia's rarity reaches the UR★ quality, the Stella feature will unlock. Increasing the Trust Level of UR★ Roxy Migurdia as a Fellow to make her your Family member (she will maintain her Fellow status at the same time).

◆ All event items will be removed or convert into other items after the event ends. Likewise, all the task and gacha progress will be removed.

Event Overview

◆ The Magic Creativity Show is being held in Drakenberg! At Trady's invitation, you'll join other companions from another world and happily take part in the competition!

Exploration

◆ In the initial state, the entire game board is shrouded in fog. Consuming stamina to clear obstacles and collect materials will gradually dispel the fog.

◆ Stamina will automatically recover over time, with 1 point restored every 5 minutes. Activating the event pass reduces the recovery time per point to 4 minutes and increases the stamina cap to 600. Additionally, stamina can be restored by using recovery items.

Exploration Buff

◆ When consuming Stamina during exploration, there is a chance to recover half of it. This probability starts at 0%.

◆ You can increase the stamina recovery probability by getting the event's exclusive characters. The return probability will increase by 10% after activating a character, with an additional 5% if the character's rarity is UR. Each time the Stella is upgraded one level, the return probability increases by 1%, with an additional 0.5% per Stella Level if the character's rarity is UR.

Main Quest

◆ The story missions will guide you in completing the Magic Creativity Show.

◆ Completing the current main quest tasks will unlock more tasks.

◆ After completing all the main quest tasks, you will get exclusive Exhibits and Titles.

Side Quest

◆ Collection tasks provide additional exploration goals other than the main storyline.

◆ Completing all collection tasks will grant generous rewards.

Event Pass

◆ Transcenders will earn battle pass points based on the stamina consumed when collecting materials and clearing obstacles.

◆ When Pass Points reach the required amount, rewards can be claimed. Purchasing the Pass unlocks premium rewards.

◆ Activate the event pass to receive 10 gacha tickets and a SSR Fellow Rudeus Greyrat, and to unlock special item effects. The pass will also allow you to reduce the stamina recovery time per point to 4 minutes and increase the stamina cap to 600 points. Total damage bonus in Sparring Challenge +10%.

Endless Exploration

◆ The Endless Exploration can be activated after completing all the main quest tasks. In this mode, stamina is consumed rapidly. Each round consumes 10 Stamina and yields item rewards.

◆ Spending stamina in Endless Exploration does not earn Pass Points or advance the task progress; instead, it increases your Achievement Points. We recommend that you use your excess stamina in Endless Exploration after completing the map exploration.

◆ The exploration buff effects on stamina recovery will also apply in the Endless Exploration mode.

Achievements

◆ Earn Achievement Points by consuming stamina during exploration. You will be able to claim corresponding rewards after reaching certain thresholds.

◆ Stamina consumed in Map Exploration and Endless Exploration will contribute to Achievement Points.

Sparring Challenge

◆ Sparring Challenge is available during the event.

◆ You can challenge 8 opponents in sequence. Each new opponent is unlocked only after defeating the previous one. Defeated opponents cannot be challenged again. After you defeat the 8th opponent, it will reset the next day, allowing another round of sparring.

◆ Each opponent defeated grants a Victory Reward. The total rewards include, but are not limited to, 10 Creativity Show Tickets.

◆ Complete Sparring Challenge achievement tasks to to unlock and claim an exclusive title.

Polaroid Album

◆ Take promotional photos of Roxy Migurdia in designated exploration areas.

◆ Before the event ends, activating “Photos in Isekai” permanently preserves these photos and additionally unlocks Roxy’s skill [Power Boost]. After the event, photos can be viewed on Roxy’s Details page.

Ranking

◆ During the event (excluding the reward claiming period), improving Fellow Roxy Migurdia's power increases your ranking score.

◆ Once the event concludes, rewards will be distributed based on ranking. If you place in the Top 3 and Roxy Migurdia's Aptitude reaches 10000, you will receive an exclusive permanent title.

Recharge Rebate

◆ During the event (including the reward claiming period), you can claim Recharge Rebate rewards by completing the corresponding tasks.

Variationオーバーロードvs異世界農園物語Overlord

クロウリーのゲームをクリアするため、異世界に迷い込んだ仲間たちと一緒に農園経営を始めた——しかし、彼らのやり方は少しまずいかも？

Duration7, 10, 14, or 21 daysDefault finish hour24:00UnlockClear Stage 4-6

Core Rewards

アルベドFellow · アルベドシャルティア・ブラッドフォールンFamily · シャルティア・ブラッドフォールンアインズ・ウール・ゴウンFellow · アインズ・ウール・ゴウンナーベラル・ガンマFellow · ナーベラル・ガンマデミウルゴスFellow · デミウルゴス変身着せ替え「漆黒のモモン」Player Costume · 漆黒のモモン
GameplayEvent Rules13 sections
注意事項

◆ 本イベントは、「オーバーロード」とのコラボイベントです。フルのイベント名は「オーバーロードvs異世界農園物語」で、略して「オーバーロード農園物語」です。

◆ イベント終了後、限定キャラクターはしばらく獲得できなくなります。

◆ 探索エリアに入り、ちょっとだけ探索すると無料でSSR仲間「アルベド」をすぐに獲得できます。または探索せず直接抽選で仲間「アルベド」を獲得し、その場合、アルベドは自動的にSSR+にランクアップします。

◆ 「アルベドの結晶の欠片」を使用し、仲間アルベドをSSR+、UR、LRまでランクアップできます。 「アルベドの結晶の欠片」は「達成報酬」、「抽選」、「引換窓口」、「パック」で獲得できます。

◆ アルベド（仲間）がSSR+になると、「リンク効果」機能が解放されます。仲間を選択してリンクすると、その仲間のパワーを大幅に上げることができます。さらに、アルベド（仲間）がLRになると、「リンクスキル」機能が解放されます。

◆ アルベドがLRになると、ステラ機能も解放されます。LR アルベド（仲間）の信頼度を上げると、アルベドと家族になれます（仲間のアルベドは消えない）

◆ イベント終了後、すべてのイベントアイテムはクリアされ、または他のアイテムに変換されます。すべてのイベントミッションの進捗と抽選の進捗もクリアされます。

Event Overview

◆ クロウリーのゲームをクリアするため、異世界に迷い込んだ仲間たちと一緒に農園経営を始めた——しかし、彼らのやり方は少しまずいかも？

探索

◆ 初期段階のマップは全体的に霧に覆われます。スタミナを消費して障害物を清掃し、素材を集めると霧を払えます。

◆ スタミナは時間経過とともに自動回復します（5分に1Pt）。バトルパスを解放すると探索スタミナの回復時間が4分になり、探索スタミナの上限が600になります。スタミナ回復アイテムを使ってスタミナを回復させることもできます。

農園経営

◆ 農園金貨：

目標は農園金貨を10,000,000枚手に入れることです！

注文を完成させ、村のレベルを上げると農園金貨を獲得できます。

◆ 農園経験値

農園経験値を貯めることで、農園レベルを上げることができます。農園の建物の修復、新しい畑の開墾、注文の納品で農園経験値を獲得できます。

農園がレベルアップすると、工房が解放され、畑管理道具を製作・使用できます。さらに、より多くの作物や注文が解放され、農園経営がより効率的になります。

◆ 農園ショップ

農園ショップ引換券を使用して農園ショップでアイテムと交換できます。注文の完了、作物の販売で農園ショップ引換券を獲得できます。イベント終了後、未使用の農園ショップ引換券はリセットされます。

◆ 注文

対応する作物を提出すれば注文が完了します。

注文完成で大量の農園経験値、農園金貨、農園ショップ引換券を獲得できます。

毎日完了できる注文数には制限があり、農園レベルを上げると、毎日完了できる注文数の上限が増えます。注文数の上限は毎日24時に更新されます。

◆ 工房

工房には畑をより効率的に管理できる機能があります：

自動田植え機：作物の種まきと収穫が自動で行われます。自動田植え機を所持した後、栽培する作物を変更する際、まず現在の畑の作物を除去してから新しい作物に植え替える必要があります。新しく開墾した畑では、自動田植え機を有効にするため、最初に手動で作物を植える必要があります。

精錬炉：エンドレス探索を解放できます。

施肥機：すべての作物の産出量+50%

水やり機：すべての作物の成熟時間-50%

ジュースマシン：リンゴを消費してスタミナを回復できます

倉庫：特定アイテムを消費して倉庫容量を増加できます

探索バフ

◆ スタミナを消費して探索するたびに、確率で消費されたスタミナの半分が返還されます。初期返還確率は0%です。

◆ 限定キャラクターを獲得すると返還確率が上がります。抽選で獲得できる限定SSR+キャラクターを1人獲得するごとに、返還確率が10%上がります。キャラクターがURにランクアップした場合、追加で5%上がります（合計確率15%）。キャラクターがLRにランクアップした場合、追加で5%上がります（合計確率20%）。また、本コラボ限定SSR+キャラクターのステラを上げるたびに、返還確率が追加で1%上がります。キャラクターがURにランクアップした場合、ステラ1レベルごとに追加で0.5%（合計確率1.5%）上がります。キャラクターがLRにランクアップした場合、ステラ1レベルごとに追加で0.5%（合計確率2%）上がります。合計確率が100%を超える場合、100%として計算されます。

メインミッション

◆ メインミッションを進めることで、農園物語を完了できます。

◆ 現在のメインミッションを完了すると、次のメインミッションが自動的に解放されます。

◆ すべてのメインミッションを完了すると、限定展示品と称号を獲得できます。

サブミッション

◆ サブミッションとは、メインストーリーと関係なく他の素材を集めるミッションです。

◆ すべてのサブミッションを完了すると、豪華報酬を獲得できます。

コラボバトルパス

◆ 素材集めと障害物の清掃時に消費されたスタミナに応じて、一定の割合のバトルパスポイントを獲得できます。

◆ バトルパスポイントが指定の数値に達すると、報酬を獲得できます。バトルパスを購入すると上級報酬を獲得できます。

◆ コラボバトルパスを購入すると、抽選券x10と変身着せ替えを獲得できるだけでなく、特殊アイテムの効果を有効化できます：バトルパスを解放すると探索スタミナ1PTの回復時間が4分になり、探索スタミナの上限が600になります。手合わせ挑戦でのダメージバフ+10%。

エンドレス探索

◆ 農園経営の精錬炉機能が解放された後、エンドレス探索ができるようになります。このモードでは、転生者は速やかにスタミナを消費できます。1ラウンドのエンドレス探索を行い、アイテム報酬を獲得するには10ptのスタミナを消費する必要があります。

◆ エンドレス探索で消費されたスタミナによって、バトルパスポイントと達成報酬ポイントを獲得できます。

◆ 探索バフのスタミナ返還ルールはエンドレス探索にも適用されます。

達成報酬

◆ 転生者はエリアでスタミナを消費して探索すると、達成報酬ポイントを獲得します。一定のポイントを獲得すると、相応の報酬を獲得できます。

◆ マップ探索とエンドレス探索で消費されたスタミナは達成報酬進行度にカウントされます。

手合わせ

◆ イベント期間中、手合わせに参加できます。

◆ イベント期間中、順番に8人の対戦相手と手合わせできます。前の対戦相手を倒さなければ、次の対戦相手は解放されません。なお、すでに倒した対戦相手と再度手合わせすることはできません。8人目の対戦相手を倒した後、その対戦相手は翌日に復活し、再度手合わせできるようになります。

◆相手を1人倒すごとに、手合わせ勝利報酬を獲得できます。合計で獲得できる報酬には農園抽選券10枚など、様々な報酬が含まれています。

◆ 手合わせの実績ミッションをクリアすると、専用称号報酬を解放して受け取れます。

◆ 今回の手合わせ報酬には特別報酬が含まれています：第6層をクリアするとSR仲間「デミウルゴス」を獲得できます

ランキングイベント

◆ イベント期間中（報酬受取期間を除いて）、仲間「アルベド」のパワーを上げることで、ランキングのポイントが上がります。

◆ イベント終了後、プレイヤーの順位に応じて報酬が配布されます。指定した条件を満たすと限定称号報酬（無期限）を獲得できます。

購入還元

◆ イベント期間中（報酬受取期間を含む）、ミッションをクリアすると対応するお得報酬を獲得できます。

GameplayEvent Rules12 sections
Special Notes

◆ This event is a collaboration with Sanrio. The event is named "Sanrio characters and Mushroom Land," and also "Kawaiimush".

◆ This event will not return in the future. After it ends, there will be no way of obtaining the event's exclusive costumes.

◆ Enter the game board for a brief play and receive the SSR Fellow Mushimi for free. You can use Mushimi's Crystal Fragments to upgrade her rarity to SSR+ and UR★. Obtain these fragments from Achievements.

◆ Once Mushimi (as Fellow) reaches the SSR+ quality, the [Resonance Effect] feature is unlocked, allowing players to Resonate with a chosen Fellow, significantly enhancing their power. Furthermore, upgrading Mushimi to UR★ unlocks the [Resonance skill] feature.

◆ When Mushimi's rarity reaches the UR★ quality, the Stella feature will unlock. Moreover, you can cultivate the Trust Level of UR★ Mushimi as a Fellow to make her your Family member (she will maintain her Fellow status at the same time).

◆ Except for Mushimi's Crystal Fragments, Mushimi's Crystal of Trust, and Mushimi's Resonance Crystal, all other event items will expire or convert into other items after the event ends, while the task and gacha progress will reset.

Event Overview

◆ Enjoy the amusement park with your new and adorable Sanrio friends!

Exploration

◆ In the initial state, the entire game board is shrouded in fog. Consuming stamina to clear obstacles and collect materials will gradually dispel the fog.

◆ Stamina will automatically recover over time, with 1 point restored every 5 minutes. Activating the event pass reduces the recovery time per point to 4 minutes and increases the stamina cap to 600. Additionally, stamina can be restored by using recovery items.

Exploration Buff

◆ When consuming Stamina during exploration, there is a chance to recover half of it. This probability starts at 0%.

◆ You can increase the stamina recovery probability by getting the event's exclusive 4-star costumes. Receiving one of these costumes for the first time increases the stamina recovery probability by 15%. Receiving them again can additionally increase the probability by 1.5%. Receiving them will increase the probability, with no need for activation or upgrading

Main Quest

◆ The main quest tasks will guide you in completing the Mushroom Land exploration.

◆ Completing the current main quest tasks will unlock more tasks.

◆ After completing all the main quest tasks, you will get exclusive Exhibits and Titles.

Side Quest

◆ Collection tasks provide additional exploration goals other than the main storyline.

◆ Completing all collection tasks will grant generous rewards.

Event Pass

◆ Transcenders will earn battle pass points based on the stamina consumed when collecting materials and clearing obstacles.

◆ Once the battle pass points reach a specified value, rewards can be claimed. Purchasing the battle pass unlocks advanced rewards.

◆ Activate the event pass to receive 10 gacha tickets and a Figure Chest, and to unlock special item effects. The pass will also allow you to reduce the stamina recovery time per point to 4 minutes and increase the stamina cap to 600 points.

Endless Exploration

◆ The Endless Exploration can be activated after completing all the main quest tasks. In this mode, stamina is consumed rapidly. Each round consumes 10 Stamina and yields item rewards.

◆ Spending stamina in Endless Exploration does not earn Pass Points or advance the task progress; instead, it increases your Achievement Points. We recommend that you use your excess stamina in Endless Exploration after completing the map exploration.

◆ The exploration buff effects on stamina recovery will also apply in the Endless Exploration mode.

Achievements

◆ Earn Achievement Points by consuming stamina during exploration. You will be able to claim corresponding rewards after reaching certain score thresholds.

◆ Stamina consumed in map exploration and endless exploration will be counted.

Event Expo

◆ During the event, a series of Expo stages will be unlocked. Each stage has 5 difficulty levels.

◆ Expo stages unlock over time. You must complete any difficulty of the previous stage to challenge next stages.

◆ Completing a stage in any difficulty level rewards you with an 10 gacha tickets.

◆ Passing all Expo challenges on any difficulty will earn you an exclusive permanent title.

Ranking

◆ During the event (excluding the reward claiming period), improving Fellow Mushimi's power can improve your ranking score. The record high Power will be the benchmark when the ranking starts. If the current power is below this benchmark, the power increase will be displayed as "0".

◆ Upon the event's conclusion, you will receive rewards based on your place in the ranking. If you ranked among the top 3, and Mushimi has reached 10000 Aptitude, you will win an exclusive permanent title.

Recharge Rebate

◆ During the event (including the reward claiming period), you can claim Recharge Rebate rewards by completing the corresponding tasks.

In spring, you and your fellows arrive at the Slime Forest for camping, but Hermes unexpectedly invites a group of guests from another world...

GameplayEvent Rules13 sections
Special Notice

◆ This event is a collaboration with That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime. Titled "Camping with A Slime," abbreviated as "Slime Camping".

◆ After it ends, there will be no way to obtain the event-exclusive characters

◆ Play through the exploration stage to claim the SSR Fellow Rimuru Tempest for free. You can use Magic Bottle to upgrade his rarity to SSR+, UR★, and LR. These items can be obtained from Achievements.

◆ Once Rimuru Tempest reaches the SSR+ quality, the [Resonance Effect] feature is unlocked, allowing you to resonate with a chosen Fellow, significantly enhancing their power. Upon upgrading Rimuru Tempest to LR, the [Resonance Skill] feature becomes available.

◆ Once Rimuru Tempest's rarity reaches the LR quality, the Stella feature will unlock.

◆ All event items will be removed or convert into other items after the event ends. Likewise, all the task and gacha progress will be removed.

Event Overview

◆ One spring day, you and your fellows head to the Slime Forest for a camping trip, only for Hermes to unexpectedly invite a group of guests from another world...

Exploration

◆ In the initial state, the entire game board is shrouded in fog. Consuming stamina to clear obstacles and collect materials will gradually dispel the fog.

◆ Stamina will automatically recover over time, with 1 point restored every 5 minutes. Activating the event pass reduces the recovery time per point to 4 minutes and increases the stamina cap to 600. Additionally, stamina can be restored by using recovery items.

Exploration Buff

◆ When consuming Stamina during exploration, there is a chance to recover half of it. This probability starts at 0%.

◆ You can increase the stamina recovery probability by getting the event's exclusive characters. The return probability will increase by 10% after activating a character, with an additional 5% if the character's rarity is UR. Each time the Stella is upgraded one level, the return probability increases by 1%, with an additional 0.5% per Stella Level if the character's rarity is UR.

Main Quest

◆ Main tasks will guide you in completing the map exploration.

◆ Completing the current main quest tasks will unlock more tasks.

◆ After completing all the main quest tasks, you will get exclusive Exhibits and Titles.

Side Quest

◆ Collection tasks provide additional exploration goals other than the main storyline.

◆ Completing all collection tasks will grant generous rewards.

Event Pass

◆ Transcenders will earn battle pass points based on the stamina consumed when collecting materials and clearing obstacles.

◆ Once the battle pass points reach a specified value, rewards can be claimed. Purchasing the battle pass unlocks advanced rewards.

◆ Activate the event pass to receive 10 gacha tickets and an SSR Fellow Benimaru, and to unlock special effects: reduce the stamina recovery time to 4 minutes and increase the stamina cap to 600.

Endless Exploration

◆ The Endless Exploration can be activated after completing all the main quest tasks. In this mode, stamina is consumed rapidly. Each round consumes 10 Stamina and yields item rewards.

◆ Spending stamina in Endless Exploration does not earn Pass Points or advance the task progress; instead, it increases your Achievement Points. We recommend that you use your excess stamina in Endless Exploration after completing the map exploration.

◆ The exploration buff effects on stamina recovery will also apply in the Endless Exploration mode.

Achievements

◆ Earn Achievement Points by consuming stamina during exploration. You will be able to claim corresponding rewards after reaching certain score thresholds.

◆ Stamina consumed in map exploration and endless exploration will be counted.

Sparring Challenge

◆ Sparring Challenge is available during the event.

◆ You can challenge 8 opponents in sequence. Each new opponent is unlocked only after defeating the previous one. Defeated opponents cannot be challenged again. After you defeat the 8th opponent, it will reset the next day, allowing another round of sparring.

◆ Each opponent defeated grants a Victory Reward. Total rewards include, but are not limited to, 10 Camp Raffle Tickets.

◆ Complete Sparring Challenge achievement tasks to to unlock and claim an exclusive title.

Ranking

◆ During the event (excluding the reward claiming period), increasing Rimuru Tempest's power will raise your ranking score.

◆ Once the event concludes, you will receive rewards based on your place in the ranking. If specific conditions are met, you will receive an exclusive permanent title.

Recharge Rebate

◆ During the event (including the reward claiming period), you can claim Recharge Rebate rewards by completing the corresponding tasks.

Event Check-In

◆ Log into the game during the event to gain Sign-In rewards.

VariationCamping with a Slime Season 2TenSuraS2

It's camping season again! Milim and Veldora are facing off for the title of "Rimuru's Most Trusted One"...

Duration7, 10, 14, or 21 daysDefault finish hour24:00UnlockClear Stage 4-6

Core Rewards

Milim NavaFellow · Milim NavaShionFamily · ShionVeldora TempestFellow · Veldora TempestLuminus ValentineFellow · Luminus ValentineCostume [Surging Through Cascades] (★4)Fellow Costume · Rimuru TempestFigure [Happy Camper]Player Costume · Happy CamperRangaFamiliar · Ranga
GameplayEvent Rules13 sections
Special Notice

◆ This event is a collaboration with That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime. Titled "Camping with A Slime Season 2," abbreviated as "Slime Camping Season 2".

◆ After it ends, there will be no way to obtain the event-exclusive characters

◆ Play through the exploration stage to claim the SSR Fellow Milim Nava for free. You can use Milim's Crystal Fragments to upgrade her rarity to SSR+ and UR★. These fragments can be obtained from Achievements.

◆ Once Milim reaches the SSR+ quality, the [Resonance Effect] feature is unlocked, allowing you to resonate with a chosen Fellow, significantly enhancing their power. Upon upgrading Milim to UR★, the [Resonance Skill] feature becomes available.

◆ Once Milim's rarity reaches the UR★ quality, the Stella feature will unlock.

◆ All event items will be removed or convert into other items after the event ends. Likewise, all the task and gacha progress will be removed.

Event Overview

◆ It's camping season again! Milim and Veldora are facing off for the title of "Rimuru's Most Trusted One"...

Exploration

◆ In the initial state, the entire game board is shrouded in fog. Consuming stamina to clear obstacles and collect materials will gradually dispel the fog.

◆ Stamina will automatically recover over time, with 1 point restored every 5 minutes. Activating the event pass reduces the recovery time per point to 4 minutes and increases the stamina cap to 600. Additionally, stamina can be restored by using recovery items.

Exploration Buff

◆ When consuming Stamina during exploration, there is a chance to recover half of it. This probability starts at 0%.

◆ You can increase the stamina recovery probability by getting the event's exclusive characters. The return probability will increase by 10% after activating a character, with an additional 5% if the character's rarity is UR. Each time the Stella is upgraded one level, the return probability increases by 1%, with an additional 0.5% per Stella Level if the character's rarity is UR.

◆ You can increase the stamina recovery probability by getting the event's exclusive 4-star costumes. Receiving one of these costumes for the first time increases the stamina recovery probability by 15%. Receiving them again can additionally increase the probability by 1.5%. Receiving them will increase the probability, with no need for activation or upgrading

Main Quest

◆ Main tasks will guide you in completing the map exploration.

◆ Completing the current main quest tasks will unlock more tasks.

◆ After completing all the main quest tasks, you will get exclusive Exhibits and Titles.

Side Quest

◆ Collection tasks provide additional exploration goals other than the main storyline.

◆ Completing all collection tasks will grant generous rewards.

Event Pass

◆ Transcenders will earn battle pass points based on the stamina consumed when collecting materials and clearing obstacles.

◆ Once the battle pass points reach a specified value, rewards can be claimed. Purchasing the battle pass unlocks advanced rewards.

◆ Activate the event pass to receive 10 gacha tickets and an SSR Fellow Luminus Valentine, and unlock special effects: reduce the stamina recovery time to 4 minutes and increase the stamina cap to 600.

Endless Exploration

◆ The Endless Exploration can be activated after completing all the main quest tasks. In this mode, stamina is consumed rapidly. Each round consumes 10 Stamina and yields item rewards.

◆ Spending stamina in Endless Exploration does not earn Pass Points or advance the task progress; instead, it increases your Achievement Points. We recommend that you use your excess stamina in Endless Exploration after completing the map exploration.

◆ The exploration buff effects on stamina recovery will also apply in the Endless Exploration mode.

Achievements

◆ Earn Achievement Points by consuming stamina during exploration. You will be able to claim corresponding rewards after reaching certain score thresholds.

◆ Stamina consumed in map exploration and endless exploration will be counted.

Sparring Challenge

◆ Sparring Challenge is available during the event.

◆ You can challenge 8 opponents in sequence. Each new opponent is unlocked only after defeating the previous one. Defeated opponents cannot be challenged again. After you defeat the 8th opponent, it will reset the next day, allowing another round of sparring.

◆ Each opponent defeated grants a Victory Reward. Total rewards include, but are not limited to, 10 Waterfall Camping Tickets.

◆ Complete Sparring Challenge achievement tasks to to unlock and claim an exclusive title.

Ranking

◆ During the event (excluding the reward claiming period), improving All Fellow's power will increase your ranking score.

◆ Once the event concludes, you will receive rewards based on your place in the ranking. If specific conditions are met, you will receive an exclusive permanent title.

Recharge Rebate
